description: Structured troubleshooting for Sage/Acorn/Lando projects — diagnoses PHP errors, Blade rendering failures, Livewire mount errors, Eloquent query issues, Acorn boot failures, queue job failures, WP hook conflicts; uses lando logs, Query Monitor, Xdebug, WP_DEBUG. Invoke for: "/debugging", "something is broken and I can't figure out why", "lando logs show an error", "acorn boot error", "blade is rendering wrong", "livewire component not mounting", "500 error", "debug this issue". Skip when: you are building or implementing features — that is /building, not debugging.
